obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen uses the privileged action manage_payees but is declared mfa=False in routes.py. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on exactly this route.

LedgerService.reopen_payee calls _audit(actor, "reopen_payee", "payee:<id>"), which records actor, action, target and the clock time. The sample control test test_sampled_operations_are_audited passes.
Store.reopen_payee only updates status and closed_at and writes no NPI column. The exhaustive test test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passes.
The new statement is a fixed string literal with payee_id bound as a parameter, and no statement text is built from data. The exhaustive test test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passes.
Ticket CHG-24857 was approved by change manager Grace Kim at 2026-10-11T05:03Z, before review. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover all four touched files.
Mara Costa, a payments change_approver and not the author (Aisha Bello), gave a code_review approval.
Both approvals name the head commit 331108b, which is the only commit on the change.

The CI run on the head commit has result 'failure': 1 of 172 tests fails, and it is the registered MFA-1 control test. The JUnit report's timestamp (2026-10-23) and host (a personal Mac) also do not match run.json (ci-runner-04, 2026-10-12).
Security-sensitive components were touched (payments.http, routes, store). Kofi Mensah, a security_reviewer, gave a security_review approval on the head commit.
The change relies on EXC-0183 for the MFA-1 deviation. That exception expired on 2026-09-13, before the review time of 2026-10-16, so it does not count.
Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1, covering routes.py) lapses because routes.py changed in behaviour. The replacement evidence, the same control test, fails, so no evidence of the same strength exists.

summary: The change adds a privileged manage_payees route, POST /payees/{id}/reopen, without requiring MFA, which violates MFA-1. The exception the change cites, EXC-0183, expired a month before review and cannot cover the deviation. The change's own CI run fails on the exhaustive MFA control test, so the testing requirement and the lapsed MFA-1 evidence are not met. Ticket, independent code review and security review are in order, but the change must be rejected.
